_comment: CAP2_FRONT_OVERLAY — a GENERATOR-AUTHORED overlay system, kept strictly separate from source-derived components. Cap 2 contains no extractable decoration; this is a surface on which a mark may be drawn ON TOP of the intact source base. No author evidence is claimed for any motif.
base: cap2 (source art by plurffle, INTACT and unmodified)
not_source_derived: the base carries no emblem; nothing here is extracted from the author's work

margins.from_visor: 1 row — the overlay may not occupy row 8, which abuts the visor seam at row 9
margins.from_outline: outline cells (step 0) and any cell on the silhouette edge are excluded
margins.from_crown_top: row 4 is the crown's top edge and is excluded

primary.why: the largest square-ish rectangle wholly inside the usable set; suits a crest, circle or glyph

alternative_max_area.why: largest area, but 8x2 is a wide flat band and suits only a two-line or wordmark shape

zone.note: the primary zone is 4x3, the same DIMENSIONS as the discredited 'front panel' but a different LOCATION — rows 5-7 on the crown, not rows 9-11 on the visor

shading_conflict.finding: the crown's specular highlight occupies 5 cells at (9,6) (10,6) (8,7) (10,7) (11,7), which sit inside every usable zone
shading_conflict.consequence: any overlay big enough to carry a mark WILL cover part of the crown highlight. A 2x2 is the largest mark that avoids it entirely, which is too small to read as a shape.
shading_conflict.judgement: this matches how real caps work — a printed graphic sits over the crown's lit face — but it is a real loss of source shading and is flagged rather than hidden

contrast_rule.direction: DARK mark on the light crown
contrast_rule.why: the crown carries the base's light steps (3-5, luminance 165-254); a mark in step 0-1 (57-81) gives 84-173 luminance separation, and this is also the direction the reference photographs use
contrast_rule.note: the opposite direction was used for the discredited visor 'emblem' and is wrong here

rules.sides_and_back: EMPTY — the front crown is not visible in profile or from behind
may_not: alter any source pixel outside the bounded overlay cells
extend outside the usable cell set
